infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SafeRoute needs your location to calculate the safest walking and driving paths in Delhi.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SafeRoute uses continuous background location to monitor your journey and detect unexpected deviations.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SafeRoute records a 10-second emergency audio clip when SOS is activated.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SafeRoute takes an emergency photo to assist first responders when SOS is triggered.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: SafeRoute lets you select trusted emergency contacts directly from your phone address book.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: SafeRoute requires background location access to ensure your trip tracking survives screen lock.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SafeRoute to capture emergency photographic evidence during an SOS alert.
